methods.outlier_charge: Robust z-score on log amounts (median / MAD), flagged at |z| >= 3.5; peers are the vendor's own invoices when it has 8+, else all invoices with that charge (12+).
methods.unusual_invoice: Isolation Forest (200 trees, 2% contamination) on log charge amounts; needs 40+ invoices.
methods.fx_rate: Deviation of 3% or more from the median rate of the same currency in the same month (3+ invoices), else overall (5+).
methods.rate_change: Median amount per vendor and charge, month over month, 20% or more with 3+ invoices in both months.
methods.forecast: Holt's linear trend on complete months (6+); interval = 1.28 x standard deviation of past one-step errors.
methods.duplicates: Same invoice number more than once; same vendor + date + amount; same B/L + amount on different dates.
methods.vendor_spelling: Names equal after removing legal suffixes, or sharing a distinctive first word with similar remainder.

narrative: 2,500 invoices from 210 vendors, ₹69.93 Cr in charges before GST, dated 2023-12-31 to 2026-12-27.
The three largest vendors (FALCON FREIGHT SYSTEMS LTD., GREENPORT GLOBAL LOGISTICS LTD., Delta Clearing & Forwarding Limited) account for 3% of spend.
Sea Freight is the largest cost at 55% of spend, followed by Air Freight (13%).
2026-09 came to ₹2.48 Cr, +16% against the month before.
68 findings need a look (21 high priority); the first is: Agency Charges of ₹1,210 is only 17% of the typical amount.
417 invoices are still waiting for review (16.7% of invoices).
Expected spend for the next three months: ₹2.72 Cr, ₹2.98 Cr, ₹3.25 Cr (the same method was off by 12% on the last three months).
